dedupe_keys.name: sheetcutter pro pipeline alignment sheet generator for arcgis pro new century software

description: SheetCutter Pro is a New Century Software application that generates pipeline alignment sheets inside ArcGIS Pro; the vendor describes it as the first alignment sheet generator available for ArcGIS Pro. Alignment sheets are the strip maps and profiles that pipeline operators use for construction, inspection and integrity work. The product page states that it works with the Pipeline Open Data Standard (PODS) 4.02 and PODS 7, Esri's Utility and Pipeline Data Model (UPDM) and other models, offers an interface for viewing and navigating sheets, and supports mobile tablets so that field inspection data are immediately available for review by inspection management. The vendor argues that sheets are otherwise slow to build and disconnected from data sources. Coverage: any pipeline held in a supported data model. Format and access: a commercial ArcGIS Pro extension with a downloadable brochure. Licence and cost: paid, proprietary. Caveats: vendor material only, without pricing or technical documentation. It supports hazard exposure reviews along pipeline routes by putting asset and field data on one sheet. It relates to New Century's Express Loader, ArcGIS with UPDM and the TurboRoute generator in the catalogue.
